questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Where do you read books at school?

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 老师问你：What do you do in the morning? 请用完整英语句子回答一件你早上做的事。
questions.rubric: 检查完整句输出；动词缺失可标记 sentence_pattern_error，听不清可标记 listening_error。

questions.stem: 七点整用英语怎么说：s___ o'clock
questions.rubric: 检查时间表达；常见错误 sewen，可标记 spelling_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The cat is ___ the box. (猫在盒子里)
questions.rubric: 检查方位介词；in/on 混淆可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学问你：How do you go to school? 请用完整英语句子回答你的上学方式。
questions.answer: I go to school by bus.
questions.rubric: 检查 by + 交通方式结构；漏 by 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 在餐厅，服务员问：What would you like? 请用完整英语句子说出你想要的食物或饮料。
questions.rubric: 检查点餐表达；I'd like 结构错误可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 在图书馆想借一本书，用英语对图书管理员说一句完整的话。
questions.rubric: 检查礼貌请求句型；May I 缺失可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 和朋友聊天气，用英语说一句完整的话描述今天的天气。
questions.rubric: 检查天气句型 It's + 天气词；结构错误可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Select ALL the fruits you like:
questions.rubric: 检查 I like + 名词与水果分类；漏选/多选可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What can you do at the gym? Select ALL.
questions.rubric: 检查 can + 动词原形与运动场景；错选可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which are ways to go to school? Select ALL.
questions.answer: by bus, on foot, by bike
questions.rubric: 检查 by + 交通方式结构；多选错误可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What time do you get up in the morning? 请用完整英语句子回答。
questions.rubric: 检查完整句与时间表达；句子不完整可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which word means “跑”？
questions.rubric: 动作词义映射；错选 walk 可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He ______ (jump) high every day. → 现在时第三人称单数
questions.rubric: 检查第三人称单数 -s；漏 s 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学问你：What’s the weather like today in your city? 请用一句话回答，并说出温度感受。
questions.answer: It’s sunny and hot, about 30 degrees.
questions.rubric: 检查天气形容词 + 温度表达；缺温度可标记 sentence_pattern_error。
